# Economist Impact

> Economist Impact is a think-tank and media brand delivering research, analysis, and custom content on global challenges including health systems, climate resilience, digital transformation, and geopolitical trade dynamics.

Economist Impact combines The Economist Group's editorial expertise with research and consulting services to produce insights on sustainability, workforce development, and policy solutions across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and emerging markets. The platform publishes in-depth analysis, podcasts, and partner-driven content on priority topics including AI governance, renewable energy transitions, and value-based healthcare.

## Key Topics

- Artificial Intelligence
- Sustainability
- Digital Transformation
- Asia-Pacific
- Renewable Energy
- Workforce Development
- Health Economics
- Geopolitical Risk
- Policy Analysis
- Climate Resilience
- Value-Based Healthcare
- Circular Economy
- Data Center Security
- Trade Geopolitics

## Featured Analysis & Insights

- [How AI can power progress: The take from Davos](https://impact.economist.com/technology-innovation/how-AI-can-power-progress): AI governance and progress insights from World Economic Forum Davos 2025
- [Business in an era of heightened geopolitical instability](https://impact.economist.com/trade-geopolitics/business-era-heightened-geopolitical-instability): Briefing paper on geopolitical instability impact on business strategy and supply chains
- [Understanding the economic consequences of the covid-19 pandemic](https://impact.economist.com/health-society/understanding-the-economic-consequences-of-the-covid-19-pandemic): Analysis of COVID-19 pandemic economic impact, labor disruption, and recovery

## Health & Climate Resilience

- [Building resilient health systems: adapting to climate change](https://impact.economist.com/health-society/building-resilient-health-systems-adapting-to-climate-change): Healthcare resilience strategies for climate change impact on vulnerable populations
- [An introduction to value-based healthcare in Europe](https://impact.economist.com/health-society/introduction-value-based-healthcare-europe): Value-based healthcare policy framework and reimbursement models in Europe
- [A life-course approach to hygiene: understanding burden and behavioural changes](https://impact.economist.com/health-society/life-course-approach-hygiene-understanding-burden-and-behavioural-changes): WASH sanitation and hygiene behavior analysis for South Asia and sub-Saharan Africa

## Energy, Environment & Circular Economy

- [How to drive solutions for the success of the Global Plastics Treaty](https://impact.economist.com/energy-environment/how-to-drive-solutions-for-the-success-of-the-global-plastics-treaty): Policy frameworks for Global Plastics Treaty and circular economy waste solutions
- [Laying tomorrow's foundations](https://impact.economist.com/energy-environment/laying-tomorrows-foundations): UAE knowledge economy and renewable energy transition toward net-zero emissions
- [Outlaw Ocean: exposing human rights abuse on the high seas](https://impact.economist.com/energy-environment/outlaw-ocean-exposing-human-rights-abuse-on-the-high-seas): Ian Urbina interview on maritime crime and human rights abuse on high seas

## Trade, Geopolitics & Workforce Development

- [The next chapter: How DBS is transforming itself to be an AI-enabled bank with a heart](https://impact.economist.com/trade-geopolitics/brilliant-moves-and-bold-bets/the-next-chapter): DBS digital transformation journey with AI-enabled banking innovation
- [Bridging the skills gap: Fuelling careers and the economy in Thailand](https://impact.economist.com/trade-geopolitics/bridging-skills-gap-fuelling-careers-and-economy-thailand): Thailand workforce skills gap survey with Google on digital transformation
- [Serving the future: Young talent aims high in APAC hospitality and tourism](https://impact.economist.com/trade-geopolitics/serving-the-future/young-talent-aims-high-in-APAC-hospitality-and-tourism): APAC hospitality and tourism workforce report on young professionals post-COVID
- [Future insight: securing data centers for connected economies](https://impact.economist.com/trade-geopolitics/future-insight): Data center security resilience strategies for climate and geopolitical risks
- [Podcast | From silk road to skyscrapers: Charting the investment landscape between Asia-Pacific and the United Arab Emirates](https://impact.economist.com/trade-geopolitics/podcast-silk-road-skyscrapers-charting-investment-landscape-between-asia-pacific-and-united-arab): Podcast episode on Asia-Pacific and UAE investment landscape and trade
